events.name: Road Roster: The Newest Member
events.intro: A patch of tall grass behind a Pokémon Center, trampled flat into a ring. Youngster Joey stands in the middle in his shorts with his cap on backwards, very serious, and five Rattata sit in a row behind him like a jury. Next to him, still dripping from the beach in her rubber ring, is Tuber Dot. Her Marill has been given a tiny paper badge with a Rattata drawn on it in crayon. Joey: "The Rattata Club has a new member. She doesn't even have a Rattata." Dot: "Marill is an honorary Rattata. It said so."

success.text: Joey clears his throat and reads the club oath off a crumpled bit of paper, and Dot repeats it word for word, her Marill squeaking at every pause. The five Rattata thump their tails on the ground in a ragged drumroll. Joey shakes her hand like she has joined the Elite Four. Then they both look at you, waiting, until you clap.

effects.text: Tuber Dot joined the Rattata Club

success.text: Joey thinks about it so hard his cap slips. Joey: "It's top percentage at being round. That counts." Dot beams. Marill bounces once, perfectly round, and the vote is unanimous. You are made to sign the club register as a witness, under a drawing of a Rattata wearing a crown.

effects.text: You witnessed Tuber Dot joining the Rattata Club

events.name: Road Roster: Grading Day
events.intro: Kenji's dojo on grading day, the mat swept, the parents' benches full, the belt table laid out again. Kenji stands on his stick at the edge of the mat in his best gi. And kneeling in the line of students, hair tied back, white belt cinched tight, is Crush Girl Tamsin, the one who used to fight only to impress somebody. Kenji: "She asked to train. Every morning, before anyone else. Today she grades." Tamsin catches your eye and gives you a small, nervous nod.

success.text: Tamsin runs her form clean, her Machamp mirroring every strike, and when she finishes the hall is quiet for a breath before the parents clap. Kenji ties the new belt round her waist himself, slowly, his hands not quite steady. Tamsin bows to him, then, after a second, to you. This time she fought for nobody but herself.
Kenji: "Good. She needs someone who won't go easy." Tamsin steps onto the mat across from you and bows, and her hands are steady now.

lose.text: Tamsin beat you on her grading day

win.text: You sparred Tamsin on her grading day, and she graded

events.name: Road Roster: Two Lines in the Water
events.intro: The end of a long pier at first light, mist lifting off the water. Fisherman Elliot sits on an upturned bucket with his line out, and beside him, legs dangling over the edge in a wetsuit, is Swimmer Kai, holding a rod for the first time and holding it all wrong. Elliot: "Kai says he's only ever seen fish from underneath. I said that's the wrong side." Kai laughs. Kai: "He's teaching me patience. It's going badly."

success.text: Elliot shows Kai how to hold the rod loose, and Kai shows Elliot where the fish actually sit, because he has swum past them all his life. Between the two of them the bucket fills by noon. When you get up to go, Elliot presses his old rod into your hands, the cork grip worn to the shape of his palm. Elliot: "Kai's got his own now. Take this one."

effects.text: Elliot and Kai fished together, and Elliot gave you his old rod

events.name: Road Roster: Tea in the Garden
events.intro: Aroma Lady Rosalind's garden in the late afternoon, bees heavy in the lavender. A little iron table has been set for three, with a teapot under a knitted cosy. Gentleman Alfred sits very straight in his good coat, his cane hooked on the chair, and Rosalind pours. Rosalind: "Alfred says his cottage has no flowers since his wife passed." Alfred, softly: "She did the garden. I only ever did the tea."

success.text: You sit with them while the shadows get long. Rosalind talks about soil and Alfred talks about his wife, and somewhere in it they find they were at the same flower show forty years ago. When it is time to go, Rosalind digs up a moonflower, roots and all, wraps it in damp newspaper and puts it in Alfred's hands. Alfred: "For the cottage. She would have liked it." His eyes are wet, and he does not hide it.

effects.text: Rosalind gave Alfred a moonflower for his cottage

success.text: You walk Alfred home with the moonflower in a pot, Rosalind's Bellossom riding on your shoulder. In the little empty bed under his window you dig the hole together, and Alfred kneels for the first time in years to press the soil down. Alfred: "There. Now she has a flower again." The Bellossom dances once round the pot before you go.

effects.text: You planted a moonflower at Alfred's cottage

events.name: Road Roster: Page Forty-Two, Returned
events.intro: Rex's little museum, the room with one card under one light. Rex is dusting the glass when the door opens and Burglar Quinn comes in, cap in his hands, no mask, looking smaller than you have ever seen him. He holds a battered card sleeve to his chest. Quinn: "Page forty-two went through my hands once. I never said sorry to your face. I'm bringing it back myself."

success.text: Rex listens to the whole apology without a word, his costume rustling. Then he lifts the glass, and Quinn sets page forty-two back in its case with his own hands, very carefully, as if it might bruise. Rex: "There. Now it's home twice." Quinn stands in front of the glass for a long time, and when he leaves he shakes Rex's hand with both of his.

effects.text: Quinn returned page forty-two to Rex in person

events.name: Road Roster: The Night Shift
events.intro: A Pokémon Center late at night, the lights turned low. Behind the counter, in pink aprons that do not suit either of them, stand Boris and Jessa, the two grunts who walked away from Team Rocket. Boris is folding towels. Jessa is reading a first-aid manual with her tongue between her teeth. Jessa: "Nurse Joy gave us the night shift. We don't charge you." Boris: "We don't charge anyone. That's the whole job."

success.text: Boris takes your Poké Balls like they might break and sets them on the machine, and Jessa hums along to its little tune. Every one of your Pokémon comes back rested and bright. Boris: "Come back any time this side of the mountains. We're here all night." For the rest of the region, their door is open to you.

effects.text: Boris and Jessa healed your team at their Center

events.name: Road Roster: Joint Patrol
events.intro: A ranger station at the forest edge, two mugs steaming on the rail. Pokémon Rangers Hal and Willa stand over a map pinned with coloured tacks, arguing in the friendly way of people who will agree in a minute. Willa: "We patrol together now. Two Rangers, one forest." Hal taps a path through the trees. Hal: "This one's ours. Nothing bad happens on it while we're walking it."

success.text: You walk the patrol path with them while the light turns green and gold through the leaves. Hal's Pokémon goes ahead, Willa's brings up the rear, and every wild Pokémon you pass simply watches you go by. At the far end Willa marks the path on your map with a ranger's green pen. Willa: "Any forest you're in, we'll have one path covered."

effects.text: You walked a joint patrol with Rangers Hal and Willa

events.name: Road Roster: The Swim Club
events.intro: A sheltered cove, the water so clear you can see the sand ripples. Three heads bob in the swell: Swimmers Marina, Kai and Finn, with a Dewgong, a Lapras and a very small hand-painted sign on a buoy that says SWIM CLUB. Marina: "We made it official. Three members." Finn: "Four, if you want." Kai: "And whenever you need to cross water, you won't go round."

success.text: They take you out past the headland on the Lapras's back, Marina in front, Finn and Kai racing alongside, laughing, and the next stretch of sea goes by under you in no time at all. When they set you down, Finn ties a strip of the club's blue towel round your wrist. Marina: "Members don't wait for boats."

effects.text: You joined the Swim Club with Marina, Kai and Finn

events.name: Road Roster: Double Doubles
events.intro: The promenade at dusk, the railing strung with lights. Cool Couple Leon and Sky, in their matching jackets, stand face to face with Dan and Eri, newly married and still a little shy about it, all four of them grinning. Sky: "Two couples. One battle." Eri: "And you. Someone has to stand across from all four of us."

success.text: Leon: "Stylish." Dan: "And strong." Four Poké Balls open at once, two pairs side by side, and the promenade crowd gathers along the railing to watch.

lose.text: Both couples beat you in a double-double battle

battle.name: Leon and Sky, Dan and Eri

win.text: You beat both couples in a double-double battle

success.text: You sit on the railing and watch the four of them battle each other instead, couple against couple, Volbeat's light trailing round Altaria's wings. Nobody really wins. Sky calls it a draw, and Eri agrees, and they all go for chips.

effects.text: You watched both couples battle on the promenade

events.name: Road Roster: The Referee
events.intro: A school playground on a Saturday, chalk lines drawn on the tarmac for a battle field. On one side, Amy and Tim with Plusle and Minun; on the other, Twins Nia and Mia in their matching hats with Pikachu and Pachirisu. Four kids, four Pokémon, and a whistle on a string that they hold out to you. Tim: "Four on four. You're the referee." Mia: "A fair one. Not like our dad."

success.text: You blow the whistle and the playground erupts. Sparks everywhere, Pachirisu darting between legs, Plusle and Minun cheering each other on. You call every faint honestly, even the close ones. At the end it is Amy and Tim by a whisker, and the twins shake their hands without being told. Nia: "That was fair. Can we do it again?"

effects.text: You refereed a four-on-four kids' battle, and called it fair

success.text: With one Pokémon left on each side and everyone exhausted, you blow the whistle long and hard and call it a draw. Four kids collapse on the tarmac laughing. Amy: "A draw means everyone gets ice cream." Nobody can argue with that, so you buy it.

effects.text: You refereed a four-on-four kids' battle, and called it a draw
